mechanism_narrative: The sharp rebound in WORKPLACES from t-2w to t-0w signals a return of routine commuting that should lift nearby retail visits with a 2-to-4 week lag, pushing RETAIL_REC above its last-four-week mean.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -53.3 at t-2w to -18.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: The hypothesis is rejected if RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the previous four-week mean within 4 weeks after WORKPLACES improves for two consecutive weeks.

failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if RETAIL_REC does not improve within 2 weeks in episodes where TRANSIT stays below -35 and WORKPLACES rises week-on-week.
